describe: one-way mainline freight diesel locomotive seen from straight above: one driving cab only, at the front (right) end, its dark windscreens facing forward; behind it a long engine hood with two big round radiator fans and an exhaust stack, a blue and light grey roof, a walkway with handrails along both sides, and at the rear (left) end a plain flat hood end with no cab and no windscreen, no text or emblem
